inputProvenance.costSource: Replay configuration btc-eth-distributional-v11.0.0; configured taker fees and execution/funding reserve

interpretation: No action or horizon is recommended from later-period returns; all comparisons remain in prespecified horizon/side order.
Use matched common rows for horizon/family differences; individualInvalidCoverage is coverage diagnostics with no return ranking.
Only FIXED_CONTROL keeps stops/targets constant across horizons. Volatility and legacy differences also change exit rules.
Locked policies were selected before later data; they are static diagnostic benchmarks, not the current conditional engine or deployed settings.
Flat policies or zero filled trades do not establish profit; insufficient common panels/days can keep every benchmark flat.
An unknown selected path leaves the policy mean and standardized-dollar result null. Known-only return averages are deliberately omitted.
Net returns already include costs and partial-fill weighting. normalizedNetUsdAt12 is hypothetical normalization, not exact cash or account P&L.
BTC and ETH are separate counterfactual arms; do not sum them into a shared-portfolio profit.
Excluded common panels include boundary purges and unknown outcomes. Short-path diagnostics can remain known without supporting a matched comparison.
Chronological later recordings were available during design and are not claimed to be an untouched holdout; the lower bound is approximate.
